manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released at the top fall together. Both have acceleration -g at the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes show a tossed ball and a ball held by a gate at the apex height. The gate opens at the top and both then fall together. Arrows show velocity and acceleration.
